brief.zh: 编号 0 到 n−1 的机柜由 cables 中的双向电缆连接。每根电缆各做一次独立断线试验，试验后恢复原网。返回每次断线后，有多少无序机柜对从原先能互通变成不能互通，同一机柜不和自己配对。按电缆的输入顺序报告，两根并行线可互为备份。
brief.en: Cabinets 0 to n−1 are joined by the two-way cables in cables. Test each cable failure independently, restoring the network between tests. For each cable, report how many unordered pairs of distinct cabinets that could communicate lose contact. Report in cable order. Parallel cables can back each other up.

label.en: Survey both ends of the cut
